sn53.1-12:1.5: paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ → paṭhamajjhānaṁ (bj); pathamam jhānam (pts) | dhammehi → missing in S1. (pts note) | jhānam → S1-3 pathamajjhānam. (pts note)
